body_lead: Thiruvananthapuram: In light of the rising road accidents and traffic violations in the state, the second phase of AI camera implementation is underway. The police will take charge of installing these cameras. The traffic IG was given instructions to prepare a report. The decision was made during a meeting called by ADGP Manoj Abraham. Currently, 675 AI cameras installed by the Motor Vehicles Department (MVD) are operational. The new cameras will focus on routes not covered by the existing MVD cameras, with priority given to 374 high-risk blackspots.
